scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/grid-core && npm run build -w packages/react-grid
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc -p packages/grid-core && tsc -p packages/react-grid && tsc -p test/types
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && npm run build:pages --workspace examples/react
scripts.preview:demo: npm run build:demo && npm run preview:pages --workspace examples/react
